messages:
Jules (product): Quick sync — we need a concise set of deployability safeguards and clear owner handoffs before we call this ready for general availability. Focus: minimal gating across SLA, docs, support, monitoring, and pricing. Who can own each?

Sam (eng-runtime): I can own runtime & SLA knobs. Propose: two tiers (standard/priority) with clear latency p95 targets and fallback model policy. Need confirmation on quantization variants we will accept for priority tier. :thinking_face:

Priya (devex): I'll take docs & SDK examples. Will draft a "ship-minimum" runbook and a short customer-facing FAQ. Quick ask: do we want sample code that shows explicit `fallback_model` handling, or just note it in the release notes?

Ken (sre): I can own monitoring and on-call routing. Immediate requirements: 1) p95/p99 traces in Console per model, 2) per-route error-rate alerts, 3) an automated rollback trigger if error-rate > 3% for 5m. Also need a blameless runbook placeholder.

Jules (product): Good. For owners: Sam -> SLA/runtime/config, Priya -> docs + customer comms, Ken -> monitoring + runbook + oncall. I can coordinate pricing gating and finalize rollout policy with sales.

Sam (eng-runtime): Implementation notes: continuous batching may raise p95 in bursts; we should document a recommended `max_batch_latency_ms` and a default `burst_capacity` setting. Also want to keep an automated model-variant fallback list so if priority quantized variant is unavailable we fallback to unquantized compatible variant.

Priya (devex): Drafting runbook checklist now. Will include this snippet for the quickstart section:
```
# Minimum GA deploy checklist
- Confirm SLA tier definitions and owners
- Docs: quickstart + migration notes for quantized models
- Monitoring: dashboard + alerts + runbook link
- Support: Tier routing + escalation matrix
- Pricing: published unit math and examples
```

Ken (sre): For alerts, suggest these thresholds (happy to adjust):
- p95 latency > 600ms for 10m -> P2
- request error rate > 3% for 5m -> P1
- model timeout rate > 0.5% for 15m -> P1
Will wire these into OpsPager. Also need an SLO burn rate dashboard for first 72h after rollout.

Jules (product): Pricing gating: I'll publish a simple table with unit cost examples and a conservative burst allowance for early customers. Sales wants a "pilot" price band for a small set of customers — that's separate from GA pricing.

Sam (eng-runtime): Two operational constraints to call out in the docs: 1) quantized variants may not support some function-calling edge formats, 2) long-run KV-cache warmup can increase early-token latency. Recommend adding an explicit note in the migration guide.

Priya (devex): Noted. I'll add a small "known limitations" section with bullets and link to the runtime FAQ. Also will prepare a single-page runbook for CSMs that lists: who to contact (Ken), who owns SLA disputes (Jules), how to escalate infra (Sam).

Ken (sre): Oncall rota: want a 2-week rotation for first month post-GA, then re-evaluate. Also request a dedicated slack channel with auto-forwarding from alerts. OpsBot can create channel if we give it a name.

Jules (product): Channel name: `#prod-entry-launch-ops`. Priya will own the channel creation and the pinned runbook.

OpsBot: scheduled: canary deployment set for 2025-08-19T22:30Z (canary group = 5% traffic). Will post status updates during rollout.

Sam (eng-runtime): For canary we should enable `fallback_model` and set conservative batching (`max_batch_latency_ms=20`). Also enable KV-cache warmup disable for first 10k requests to avoid high start latencies.

Priya (devex): Action items I'm tracking:
- Draft runbook + FAQ (deadline: 2 business days)
- Create `#prod-entry-launch-ops` and pin artifacts (today)
- Prepare customer comms draft for pilot band (Jules review)

Ken (sre): My action items:
- Create dashboards & alert rules (48h)
- Configure OpsPager & rota (48h)
- Add rollback automation stub to CI pipeline (Sam + Ken pairing)

Sam (eng-runtime): My action items:
- Document `max_batch_latency_ms` defaults and fallback policy in infra README (48h)
- Expose SLA tuning knobs in Console (PR target: 72h)
- Confirm quantized vs unquantized compatibility matrix (48h)

Jules (product): I'll draft the pricing table and pilot qualification criteria and share a one-pager. Final decision: if monitoring + runbook + canary + docs are complete and no P1s in canary window, we allow GA flip. Otherwise extend pilot.

Priya (devex): Cool. I'll post the runbook draft back here when ready. :+1:

Ken (sre): 👍

Sam (eng-runtime): 👍

Jules (product): Thanks team — closing this thread once runbook + canary pass.
